fields.statement: Re-ran the leaf's tests at d145f9a in a detached worktree with RHIZA_* unset; all pass. internal/api/run_fixleaf_test.go TestFixLeafEngine runs the engine over a real git repo (evidenceCommitRunner: git init + rhiza init, real commit/trailer judging) and asserts each clause: for confirmed major f1 on leaf-a the fixer prompt contains 'fix leaf leaf-a in cycle 2', 'alpha f1', 'major', 'fix.go:1', the reason and '`Leaf: leaf-a`'; the fixer's new commit has Leaf trailer leaf-a and its judgement passes on that commit; the verifier spec Commit and its checkout HEAD equal the fix commit (checkout removed after); the verifier judgement is 'Evidence written by the verifier' and the Evidence commit's Actor trailer equals the verifier actor's name; check sessions are exactly alpha check 1, beta check 1, alpha critic 1, alpha check 2 (only the failed check re-runs) and the verifier is judged before cycle 2's check starts; no leaf outcome entry. TestFixLeafEngineNoCommit asserts a fixer with no commit naming leaf-a fails: step fails, no verifier starts, no cycle-2 check session, fixer judgement 'no new commit since ...', alpha cycle 2 failed with 'cycle 2: fix failed: leaf leaf-a: fixer failed: ...'. Unit tests TestFixLeafOrder/NoCommitFailsCycle/VerifierFailsCycle/NoneWithoutLeafFindings, TestFixActions, TestNextCheckActionsFixPhase pass. git show d145f9a (fixActions/fixFindings in internal/run/checks.go, fixerPrompt in internal/api/run_leaves.go) matches the acceptance.
